name: European Central Bank — ECB Data Portal API
access: HTTPS GET to data-api.ecb.europa.eu (SDMX REST, csvdata); no key described

rate_limit.source: The ECB publishes no rate limit or fair-use policy on fetched pages (CAP-DATA-07 open question). Self-imposed polite pacing: one request every 2 s.

failure_behavior: Connection errors, 429 or 5xx (HTTP 503 was reported once by a researcher): bounded exponential backoff, then the run fails; stored rates remain with their availability times. A currency without a fixing for a date (TARGET holiday) shows its previous fixing labelled with its own date; never 1.0 or zero.

datasets.description: Euro foreign exchange reference rates (EXR D.<CCY>.EUR.SP00.A): units of currency per 1 EUR, decimal as published
datasets.coverage: About 30 currencies against EUR (29 in the table on 2026-10-22; RUB suspended)
datasets.history_depth: Daily series history per currency via the EXR dataflow (depth per series unverified)
datasets.update_frequency: Each TARGET working day, usually around 16:00 CET after the 14:10 CET concertation
datasets.availability_rule: Live capture (fetched on or before 23:59:59 Europe/Berlin of the reference date): available at first-seen receipt time, never the 14:15 CET fixing time. Backfill: 23:59:59 Europe/Berlin on the reference date, flagged availability_estimated_backfill. Changed values on re-fetch: new publication at receipt time, flagged revised_after_first_seen.
datasets.rights_source: ECB disclaimer and copyright (free reuse if reproduced accurately with the ECB cited; modifications such as cross rates must be stated). ECB: rates are 'for information purposes only' and 'using the rates for transaction purposes is strongly discouraged' — valuation and reporting only, never order pricing or funding. Cloud-model processing not addressed by the ECB pages; withheld until the owner sets it (CAP-DATA-07).
datasets.rights_status: recorded from the capability register (CAP-DATA-07, CAP-MAC-12)

datasets.description: ECB press releases RSS (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/home/html/rss.en.html): headline, link and publication time; the feed carries no summary
datasets.coverage: ECB press releases, statements and decisions (15 items on 2026-10-23)
datasets.update_frequency: as releases are published (polled every 10 min)
datasets.availability_rule: first_seen receipt time; the feed's pubDate is kept as the publication time
datasets.rights_source: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/using-our-site/disclaimer/html/index.en.html ('Users of this website may make free use of the information obtained directly from it subject to the following conditions: When such information is distributed or reproduced, it must appear accurately and the ECB must be cited as the source'). Headlines and links only; cloud-model processing not addressed, withheld as for ecb.exr_reference
